flows.name: Write a note and see it in the list after a reload

entryPoint.how: the New note button in the list header

preconditions: signed in as a member of one workspace

actions.expected: An empty composer opens with focus in the title field

actions.action: Type a title and body, then click Save
actions.expected: The composer closes and the note appears at the top of the list
The note is still first in the list with the same title

variants.difference: The composer is a full-screen sheet; Save moves into the sheet header.

edgeCases.case: The list is asserted before the save request settles
edgeCases.expected: The row is present but its id is optimistic; assert after the network idle, not after the click.

oracle.assertion: After the reload, GET /api/notes returns a note whose title equals the typed string, and the first list row renders that same title.

flows.name: Delete a note and confirm it does not return

actions.action: Open the row menu and choose Delete
actions.expected: A confirmation dialog names the note by title
The row leaves the list and a toast offers Undo for 5 seconds

oracle.assertion: The list row count falls by exactly one and no row carries the deleted title, both before and after a reload.

waiverAudit.liftWhen: the case is unparked and runs in a blocking CI step
waiverAudit.note: The waiver is broken: the named case is test.skip, so it can never fail a build.

notes.what: No signed-out fixture exists, so the anonymous redirect is unproved.
notes.why: The dev login helper always mints a member token; there is no way to reach /notes without one.

notes.doc: docs/prd.md#notes says deletion cannot be undone.
notes.code: NoteRow.tsx renders a 5-second Undo toast and the row is soft-deleted.
notes.whichShips: The code. A journey written to the PRD would assert the row is gone immediately and fail on the toast.

notes.item: Whether Undo restores the note's original position in the list.
notes.whyNot: Read the delete handler but not the list ordering; not observed in a run.

notes: The mobile app consumes the same API and was not opened at all.
